description:
**Retargeted 2026-05-11 per `.3` decision (option B):** binding code lives in new `pkix-identity` crate; pkix-chain ships the thin wrapper that calls it.

## In `pkix-identity` (fills scaffold stub)

Implement `verify_dns_name(cert: &Certificate, name: &ServerName) -> Result<(), IdentityError>`:

- Parse leaf's SubjectAlternativeName extension; iterate `GeneralName` entries.
- For each `GeneralName::DnsName(dns)`: apply RFC 6125 §6.4 matching against `name`:
  - **Exact** case-insensitive ASCII match.
  - **Wildcard** rules: SAN entry `"*.foo.com"` matches `"a.foo.com"` but NOT `"a.b.foo.com"` (single leftmost label), NOT bare `"*"`, NOT `"*.com"` (no public-suffix check — caller responsibility), NOT embedded wildcards (`"*.foo.*.com"` rejected).
  - **IDN** handling: A-label form for DNS names; if caller provides U-label, normalize via `idna` crate before compare.
- For each `GeneralName::IpAddress(bytes)`: if `name` is an IP literal (IPv4 4 bytes / IPv6 16 bytes), byte-equal compare.
- If any SAN entry matches: `Ok(())`. If SAN is missing or no entry matches: `Err(IdentityError::NoMatchingSan)` or `MissingSan`.

Also implement `ServerName::dns_name` and `ServerName::ip_address` constructors with input validation.

## In `pkix-chain`

Ship two new public functions:

```rust
pub fn verify_tls_server(
    chain:      &[Certificate],
    anchors:    &[TrustAnchor],
    name:       &ServerName<'_>,    // from pkix-identity
    policy:     &ValidationPolicy,  // typically BasicTlsProfile.policy(now)
    verifier:   &impl SignatureVerifier,
    revocation: &impl RevocationChecker,
) -> Result<ValidatedPath, VerifyError>;

pub fn verify_tls_client(
    chain:      &[Certificate],
    anchors:    &[TrustAnchor],
    identity:   Option<&ClientIdentity<'_>>,  // typically &MailboxName for rfc822 identity
    policy:     &ValidationPolicy,
    verifier:   &impl SignatureVerifier,
    revocation: &impl RevocationChecker,
) -> Result<ValidatedPath, VerifyError>;
```

Body of `verify_tls_server`:
1. Call existing `pkix_chain::verify_chain(chain, anchors, policy, verifier, revocation)?` — produces `ValidatedPath`.
2. Call `pkix_identity::verify_dns_name(&chain[0], name)?`.
3. Return `Ok(ValidatedPath)`.

`verify_tls_client` is the same shape with optional identity binding.

`VerifyError` enum gets new variants for `HostnameMismatch`, `MalformedSan`, etc., wrapping `IdentityError`.

Whether `verify_tls_client` ships in v0.x depends on `.7` (wrapper-set decision); if only `verify_tls_server` ships, that's fine.

## Tests

- bettertls.com hostname-matching corpus (already vendored in `pkix-difftest` per AGENTS.md).
- RFC 6125 §6.4 wildcard edge cases: leftmost-label-only, no-embedded-wildcards, no-bare-asterisk.
- IDN: U-label input → A-label SAN match, both directions.
- IP literal: IPv4 / IPv6 / mismatched length.
- SAN missing → error.
- SAN present but no match → error.

## Blocks on

- New scaffold child (creates the pkix-identity crate with the API stubs).
- `.7` (decides whether `verify_tls_client` is in the v0.x wrapper set).
